gates.name: Data Validity & Reporting
gates.note: Complete data validation reports generated and verified on all three domains.
gates.evidence: movies: verified (interactions=999611, sparsity=0.9516); products: verified (interactions=231780, sparsity=0.9991); articles: verified (interactions=2353960, sparsity=0.9995)

gates.name: Temporal Split Non-Leakage
gates.note: Chronological per-user split for Movies/Products; impression-time split for Articles (F-003, D-021).
gates.evidence: Leakage tests pass on real data splits with zero future interactions in training.

gates.name: Recommendation Invariants
gates.note: Mode agreement, exclusions honored, reasons faithful, scores sorted descending.
gates.evidence: Verified across TestClient and real running server via test_phase7_gate.py and test_phase10_adversarial.py.

gates.name: Evaluation Baselines & Sanity Ordering
gates.note: Movies NDCG@5 below popularity on dense collaborative data (D-016); MIND-small impression sparsity documented in D-025.
gates.evidence: Bootstrap 95% confidence intervals computed; Random < Popularity < Model ordering verified where significant.

gates.name: Cold-Start Degradation & Attribution
gates.note: Cold-start curves computed across sizes 0..20; faithful explanations verified (P3.7, P5.7).
gates.evidence: Curves stored in metrics.json; fallback to popularity when likes < threshold verified in UI and API.

gates.name: Reproducibility & Integrity
gates.note: SHA-256 manifests match all artifact files; code_hash matches current frozen sources.
gates.evidence: movies: SHA-256 manifest and code_hash verified; products: SHA-256 manifest and code_hash verified; articles: SHA-256 manifest and code_hash verified

gates.name: Contract & Property Testing
gates.note: OpenAPI schema synchronized; property-based fuzz tests pass with zero unhandled 500 errors.
gates.evidence: 12 API endpoints contract-verified; standard error response shape enforced across all status codes.

gates.name: Latency & Resource Budgets
gates.note: p95 latency < 150ms for recommend, cold-start < 300ms, peak process RSS 1771.9 MB (< 2048 MB budget).
gates.evidence: Warm-up 50, load 500 requests per endpoint; pure numpy/scipy runtime without deep learning imports (P7.12).

gates.name: Frontend Quality & Accessibility
gates.note: WCAG 2.1 AA certified with @axe-core/playwright (0 serious/critical violations); 100% data consistency verified.
gates.evidence: Responsive across 360/768/1280px; keyboard focus traps, reduced motion respected, Vitest 69/69 passing.

gates.name: Licensing & Attribution
gates.note: MIT attribution to Microsoft Recommenders preserved; dataset licenses documented in DATASETS.md.
gates.evidence: tools/vendored_manifest.py verified; zero external 'recommenders' pip dependency.

gates.name: Security & Supply Chain
gates.note: pip-audit (0 vulns), npm audit (0 vulns), git secrets scan (0 leaks), CORS wildcard production guard (D-032).
gates.evidence: RFC 413 chunked body limits, constant-time API key comparisons, CSP/nosniff headers configured.
